rule.notes: Deterministic sampling for the pilot corpus. 'every_nth_day' takes the 1st day of the range (plus start_offset_days) and then every n-th day after it, and downloads ALL bulletins of those days. The alternative rule 'random_days' (needs 'k' and uses 'seed') picks k days with random.Random(seed). The seed is saved in the sample plan even when the rule does not use it.
